risk_flags.description: Image IMG-003-B: Tape on package shows uneven adhesion pattern inconsistent with factory application — possible resealing as claimed

justification: Visual evidence supports the claim. [IMG-003-A] Right side of box shows severe crush damage with cardboard folded inward approximately 3 inches — consistent with significant impact. [IMG-003-B] Close-up of tape shows different adhesion pattern on one seam suggesting the package was opened and resealed. [IMG-003-C] Interior shows ceramic fragments consistent with broken vase description.
